title: NotiVas v1.6.0
notes:
• Push Notifications & Links: Link push notifications directly to task and forum detail views.
• Quiz Support: Add native support and detection for Canvas new quizzes.
• Assignment Management: Show drive options only when linked, hide submission cards for unavailable assignments, allow late submissions, and format assignment consigna with rich text, lists, and inline links.
• Web File Import: Add file import picker and drag-and-drop support for assignment submissions on the web platform.
• Submission Receipts: Show submitted receipts with view and download options, quiz-style scores, and conditional reattempts.
